findings.description: Decision D-EXT-01 (Exact production Identity Provider) is RESOLVED: Google Cloud Identity / Google Workspace managed organizational identity selected via project-authorized provider selection. Google ID tokens are signed JWT identity assertions; OAuth access tokens are bearer credentials for Google APIs; audience matched to approved OAuth client ID(s); hd != canonical E-7 tenant_id; service API key remains frozen Phase-1 initial service-auth baseline.

Decision D-EXT-02 (First production calendar provider/system) is RESOLVED: Google Calendar under Google Workspace selected with BIDIRECTIONAL integration direction via project-authorized provider selection. CALENDAR_AUTHORIZATION_TOPOLOGY = TO_BE_CONFIRMED_DURING_IMPLEMENTATION (domain-wide delegation not mandatory); UTC_SAFE_TIME_HANDLING preserves timezone/all-day semantics; E-7 owns synchronization idempotency; nextSyncToken lifecycle with HTTP 410 full re-sync; HTTPS callbacks with unpredictable X-Goog-Channel-Token verification; notifications are change signals.
Production Blocker BLK-01 (Tenant/Organization Scoping Unresolved) gates live production context extraction against mysql_iredu. It does not block generic E-7 planning or synthetic testing.
Scheduling Resource Production Gate BLK-02 (Physical Academic Resource Authority Unresolved) gates automated room capacity scheduling. It does not block generic Task Intelligence planning.

E-8 production transport (DEC-E8-01), recipient resolution (DEC-E8-02), feedback contract (DEC-E8-03), template rendering boundary (DEC-E8-04), and channel selection (DEC-E8-05) remain open decisions for post-Phase-0 runtime implementation.

Existing fixture tests/fixtures/integrations/INT-NOTIFY-001.json is frozen and classified as PARTIALLY_COMPATIBLE with Task 0G.6B contract due to earlier contract top-level subject/command_type conventions.
Runtime adapter implementations for ERP (mysql_iredu), Identity, Calendar, and E-8 are NOT_IMPLEMENTED in Phase 0, in strict compliance with the architecture roadmap.

integration_engineering_baseline_justifi: All 17 required Phase-0 integration design artifacts exist across Tasks 0G.1 through 0G.6C.
